name: Plus AI
tagline: Plus AI is a presentation add-in for Google Slides and PowerPoint that generates complete slide decks from prompts, remixes existing slides, and rewrites content. It is used by consultants and business teams to create first-draft decks from meeting notes, reports, and documents in minutes.
